title.en: BELAIT MUNICIPAL BOARD STANDING ORDERS REPEAL BY LAWS 2018

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-27-2018-BELAIT-MUNICIPAL-BOARD-STANDING-ORDERS-REPEAL-BY-LAWS-2018.pdf》（2 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These By-Laws may be cited as the Belait Municipal Board (Standing Orders) (Repeal) By-Laws, 2018 and shall commence on the same date as the Kuala Belait and Seria Municipal Board (Standing Orders) By-Laws, 2014 (S 6812014). Repeal of S 9711961

The Belait Municipal Board (Standing Orders) By-Laws, 1961 are hereby repealed. Made this 17th. day of Sya'aban, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 3rd. day of May, 2018.

AWANG RIDZUAN BIN HAJI AHMAD Kuala Belait and Seria Municipal Board, Brunei Darussalam. Confirmed this 28th. day of Sya'aban, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 14th. day of May, 2018.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA SERI KERNA DATO SERI SETIA (DR.) HAJI AWANG ABU BAKAR BIN HAJI APONG Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
